execution_contract_policy.REAL_CAMERA_E2E: Real CameraX capture and production recognition pipeline; never use RESP-* as its outcome oracle.
execution_contract_policy.REAL_MODEL_GALLERY: System Photo Picker input and production Detector/Crop/Classifier; camera_capture_trace is a negative proof of zero CameraX requests for legacy validator compatibility.
execution_contract_policy.CONTROLLED_UI: Controlled result payloads drive UI/state assertions; not real-model evidence.
execution_contract_policy.CONTROLLED_FAILURE: Test-only failure/event injection; not real-model evidence. Release entry points are forbidden.
execution_contract_policy.legacy_execution_mode: Retained for the current read-only catalog validator; normative submode is execution_contract.
